facts.note: Transcript says that when the temple struck nine, Aurèle had everyone show him their watches, and Vauthier's watch was two minutes ahead of the bell. 'Inspected' is reworded as 'had us all show him our watches'; the timepiece, reading and relation match.

Piquet in the salon until a quarter to eleven by Vauthier's watch, then he went to the hall for his cigar case from his coat. Madame began the piano as he went out and stopped when he came back. All of this matches.
When the temple struck ten during the game, the salon clock showed five minutes to ten, and he remarked on it to Madame. Matches.
